[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/01 (Wed) 21:42  
[USER] User is looking to improve their 5K time.  
[USER] User is experiencing tightness in their IT band and hip flexors, especially after Saturday morning bike rides.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Interval training is an excellent way to improve 5K performance by increasing speed, endurance, and overall running efficiency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended interval training workouts include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **1. Fartlek Intervals**: Warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, alternate between 1-2 minutes of fast running and 2-3 minutes of active recovery for 20-30 minutes, cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **2. 400m Interval Workout**: Warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, run 400m at a fast pace, walk or jog for 200m to recover, repeat for 3-5 sets, cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **3. Hill Repeats**: Find a route with a gradual incline, warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, run up the hill at high intensity, walk or jog back down to recover, repeat for 3-5 sets, cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **4. 800m Interval Workout**: Warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, run 800m at a fast pace, walk or jog for 400m to recover, repeat for 2-3 sets, cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **5. Pyramid Intervals**: Warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, run 200m, recover for 200m, run 400m, recover for 400m, run 600m, recover for 600m, run 400m, recover for 400m, run 200m, cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **6. Proportional Intervals**: Warm up with 10-15 minutes of easy running, run at a fast pace for 1 minute, recover for 2 minutes, run for 2 minutes, recover for 4 minutes, run for 3 minutes, recover for 6 minutes, cool down with 10-15 minutes of easy running.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for interval training: Start with one or two workouts per week, warm up and cool down properly,
